status: Native CUDA small-batch routed EXL3 FFN component qualified; session executor integration and full-model admission remain open; whole goal active

api.scope: Explicit routed FFN component; no implicit shared-expert computation, residual addition or ordinary generation admission
api.views: Thirteen exact disjoint request-owned views; metadata binding on GPU; caller zeroes counters once during setup and retains immutable expert leases through completion
api.bindings: At most 48 borrowed expert triples, each from this backend and matching quant marker/dimensions/payload. Caller must bind all selected nonzero-weight experts for the complete routed output. Unlisted/out-of-range IDs are masked; this is not a cross-window accumulation API.
api.resources: No explicit allocation, host copy or synchronization in the operation. Scratch and input/output buffers are budgeted by the caller. Larger widths use the device shared-memory ceiling so one request cannot lower another request width's kernel limit.

source.adaptation: Only attribution banners on those two headers. Private parameter header removes ATen dependency and unused host declarations. Native backend adds validation, borrowed-weight binding and default host launch policy; reuses existing sanitized codec/utility headers.
source.math: F16 raw gate/up GEMV; F32 output transform, SiLU/clipping and down-input rotation; F16 down input; raw F32 down GEMV; F32 post-transform and original sixteen-warp weighted reduction. No prefill activation or fixed-top-k reduction substitution.
source.launch: GPU metadata binding, optional rotation/run-table kernel for R>1, then ordinary A/B launches. Source slots_max remains 8*topk; default split policy and row grouping are preserved.

correctness.comparison: Every written routed intermediate/output and preserved input is byte-exact against independently captured source results. One request reused across forward and reverse case order, with two calls per case and no host counter clearing.
correctness.synthetic: Sixteen original-source fixtures at D=H=128,E=8,K=6, rows1..8, clips0/10; two requests, two calls each =>64 executions, including malformed plan/ownership/aliasing checks and allocation guards.
correctness.preserved_original_and_paired: Original cuBLAS and paired system-library reference sets remain intact. Custom routed outputs are identical across them. Shared/final BLAS-dependent results remain separately preserved; this component does not recompute shared outputs.

trace.scope: One warmed R8 layer39 learned-router selected expert FFN, clip10; weights/input/request setup, router, shared FFN and comparisons outside capture

kernel_groups.name: bn_cuda_decode_detail::bind(BnCudaDecodeEXL3Pointers, long *, long *, const int *, int, int)

trace.limitation: Component trace only, no full-model latency or vLLM parity measurement

limitations: The production transformer Trellis session executor still rejects <=8 tokens; wiring this operation into its request resources and offload lease lifecycle is next.
Layer39-only FFN qualification does not establish full-model execution. V4.1 defaults to zero hash-routing layers; all40 use learned routing.
Native full attention, Engram, complete model forward, generation and CLI admission remain open.
Device qualification is on the selected 188-SM sm_120a GPU only; generic API shape bounds are not a claim of all-shape/all-GPU reference qualification.
Warm trace excludes routing, shared FFN, expert loading and full-model execution; it establishes no vLLM performance parity.
